Iter571 TEACHER — iter570 PASS but THIN (3.6875). Two findings drive iter571:
  (a) Q1 composition re-probe 2.50 HALF-LANDED: iter570 COMBINED CANONICAL fixed IGNORE NULLS placement + put forward-fill on post-join rows, BUT responder MIGRATED the anti-pattern into a PRE-JOIN CTE: `sparse_logs AS (SELECT ..., LAST_VALUE(cpu_percent) OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY logged_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS latest_cpu ...)`. Over the FULL frame, LAST_VALUE returns the PARTITION-GLOBAL-LAST value (a constant per server), so forward-filling that makes EVERY row show the server's globally-latest reading, not the as-of-bucket value. ALSO LEFT-JOIN FANOUT (sparse_logs not aggregated to one row per (server,hour)). iter570's DO-NOT-WRITE catches the OUTER-select window but NOT a pre-join CTE window or fanout.
  (b) Q4 NEW cross-engine slip: `'1900-01-01'::timestamp` uses the PostgreSQL `::` cast operator — NOT valid Trino 467 (GitHub issue #23795 / PR #25259 OPEN, not merged); Trino requires `CAST(x AS type)` / `TRY_CAST`. Parse error in dbt-trino-compiled model.

WebSearch verification (verbatim quotes):
  - Trino 467 window functions doc (trino.io/docs/467/functions/window.html): LAST_VALUE 'Returns the last value of the window.' With ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING, the frame encompasses all rows from the beginning to the end of the partition, so LAST_VALUE returns the value from the final row in that partition — every row in the partition sees the same partition-global-last value (this confirms the iter571 finding: full-frame LAST_VALUE in a pre-join CTE collapses to a per-entity constant). The doc also states 'By default, null values are respected. If IGNORE NULLS is specified, all rows where x is null are excluded from the calculation.'
  - max_by(x, y) is already canonical in r23 §3.1D (verbatim from trino.io aggregate.html): 'Returns the value of x associated with the maximum value of y over all input values.' Confirmed valid Trino 467 — used in Step 2a's one-row-per-bucket pre-aggregation.
  - GitHub issue #23795 (https://github.com/trinodb/trino/issues/23795, opened 2024-10-15): title 'Cast operator ::'. Initial body: 'Add support for x::type cast operator as an alternative syntax for CAST(x AS type).' Status: OPEN. References PR #25259 (also OPEN, NOT merged). The :: cast token does NOT exist in Trino 467's grammar — parse error 'mismatched input :::'.
